{{Top|leg}}
'''Transit Red''' was a route of the free-to-use system of [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxis]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eusebus]], [[Euceron]]. The end of the line for Transit Red was located in a spot where the buildings of the city abruptly ended.<ref name="Dangerous Game">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>
